name: Muñomer del Peco (Spain)
description: Quartered yellow and red, the yellow quarters each charged with a red cross flory.
history: On 23 March 2013 the municipal council approved the arms and the flag; the flag is a transposition of the quartered arms onto the cloth, the cross flory coming from the arms of the Muñoz lineage, probable origin of the name.

features.role: cross flory in each yellow quarter
